summary.prose: Story s4 puts the 22 existing git tools on the registry's typed contract (typebox schemas that serialise to the same input JSON, a checked output shape, a failure kind on every failed result, and an approval class chosen from the call's input), adds twelve new git tools so the repository's own git reads can leave their private spawns, and records in a coverage table which of git's 169 commands are covered here, left to s8 or excluded. It starts with the shared pieces (failure helpers, runShellBytes, parsers), converts the existing tools in two groups, adds the new tools in two groups, then registers, covers and documents everything; a verification task confirms the late review fixes before the one full sweep.

tasks.title: Typed failures for git tools

Expected non-zero outcomes (amend, reset, merge helper reads) stay apart from process failures.

Legacy output and error text of each failing call is unchanged
The existing git tool tests pass unchanged after this task, before t4 and t5 build on it
Expected non-zero outcomes of the amend, reset and merge helper reads are not reported as process failures

tasks.title: The other seventeen tools: typebox, output schemas and per-input approval classes
tasks.summary: For git_stage, git_commit, git_amend, git_push, git_pull, git_fetch, git_reset, git_merge, git_rebase, git_revert, git_cherry-pick, git_checkout, git_branch, git_tag, git_stash, git_worktree and git_remote rewrite inputSchema as typebox with identical JSON, declare outputSchema, apply assertSafeArg and terminators, and set approval as a function of the input: destructive for hard reset, force or plus-prefixed or colon-delete push, branch and tag delete, stash drop and clear, worktree remove with force, checkout of a path or with discard; common otherwise, none for reads such as branch, tag, stash, worktree and remote listing. Post-mutation secondary reads (commit numstat, stage, revert, checkout, cherry-pick) keep placeholders and add data.warnings; precondition reads (git_reset and git_push lookups) fail the call before any change. Add the grep test that pins the inventory of ignored secondary lookups. Reject empty git_stage paths and git_fetch depth below 1.
acceptanceChecks: All 22 existing git tools (the five of t4 and these seventeen) declare an outputSchema
Every destructive operation listed in the LLD asks in every mode, including auto, and is not run when declined
Every non-destructive mutation and read resolves to common or none as listed
A failed post-mutation secondary read leaves the mutation's result successful with data.warnings; a failed precondition read fails before anything changes
The grep test fails when an ignored secondary lookup is added that the inventory does not list
Typebox input schemas serialise to the same JSON as before
